name: Fish in bamboo
summary: Cá lam ống is a Xá Phó plate at thôn Nậm Sang, in Nậm Sài, about 30 km south of town. The page names the dish and does not describe the tube.
origin: The national Nậm Sài piece, and the provincial reprint of the same meal.
howToEat: At a household meal in the village. A method is check on arrival.
where: Thôn Nậm Sang, about 2.5 km from the Nậm Sài commune center. The commune is about 30 km south of town. Any Xá Phó house, not a named restaurant.
seoTitle: Fish in bamboo at Nam Sang — a household meal
seoDescription: Cá lam ống at Xá Phó houses in thôn Nậm Sang, about 30 km south of Sa Pa. A restaurant name was not printed.
